summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting a credit agreement amendment. Limbach Facility Services LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary of Limbach Holdings, Inc., entered into the Third Amendment to its Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement with Wheaton Bank & Trust Company, N.A. The amendment increases the revolving credit facility from $100M to $125M, reduces applicable margins based on the borrower's Senior Leverage Ratio, and revises certain definitions. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign is involved. This is a routine refinancing and credit line expansion, not a special situation.
